ns2:course.label: Startups: Inc, Fund, Contracts, IP
ns2:course.description: Explore legal tools used in constructing and operating companies. Topics include: issues with business formation, intellectual property, NDA, contracts, and other corporate legal issues impacting startups. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MS: Civil Engr - Online - UIUC, MCS: Computer Sci Online-UIUC, MS: Aerospace Engr-Online-UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC, or MENG:Mech Engineering Onl-UIUC.
